events.description: A sustained violent unrest event involving multiple riot police in full gear forming a line, while in the background individuals (some in yellow protective suits) are engaged in active confrontation near a fire and smoke; debris is scattered on the ground, and the scene shows dynamic movement consistent with ongoing clashes.

Mutual physical combat observed between individuals in yellow protective gear and others in dark tactical gear near the fire; visible grappling, pushing, and close-quarters struggle across multiple frames.

Sustained violent unrest involving protesters and police in riot gear, with barricades, smoke, and fire on the street; multiple individuals wearing gas masks and holding shields, indicating active confrontation.
A sudden bright flash and rapid expansion of flame on the ground, consistent with a small explosive device (e.g., Molotov cocktail or incendiary) detonating or igniting upon impact.

Physical engagement between riot police and protesters: officers in tactical gear advance while one appears to strike or push against an individual behind a shield; visible contact and forceful movement suggest mutual or one-sided physical combat.

A group of riot police in full protective gear (helmets, shields, vests) are engaged in a violent confrontation at a gated entrance; flames and smoke are visible as objects burn near the gate, and officers are actively maneuvering under fire or incendiary attack.

Direct physical engagement occurs between riot police and an unseen adversary: one officer is struck by a flaming object and recoils, while others press forward with shields amid smoke and fire, indicating mutual combat.

Multiple uniformed officers are restraining a man lying on the ground; one officer is kneeling on or near the man's torso/neck area while others hold his limbs, and the man appears distressed with visible facial injury (blood near mouth/nose). The man is not resisting and is in a vulnerable position throughout the sequence.

Multiple uniformed officers are restraining a man lying on the ground; one officer is seen pressing or applying force to the man's head/face area while others hold his limbs, and later a plastic bottle is used to pour liquid onto his face while he remains restrained and unable to resist.

A chaotic scene with multiple uniformed personnel (some in riot gear, others in fire/rescue uniforms) actively engaged around a burning structure and ground fires amid heavy smoke; individuals are moving rapidly, some appear to be deploying extinguishers or engaging in physical interventions, consistent with violent unrest or a large-scale public disturbance.

At least two individuals in dark riot gear are seen physically grappling—one is bent over while another appears to be restraining or striking them—near the right side of the frame (e.g., f10–f15), indicating mutual physical combat.

A sustained violent clash between riot police in full protective gear and a group of individuals near a burning barricade and fence; officers are actively engaging, pushing, and using force while some individuals retreat or are subdued.

Direct physical combat occurs near the fire: individuals in civilian clothing engage in hand-to-hand struggle with police officers; one person is seen on the ground being restrained by multiple officers while others grapple nearby.
A person appears subdued on the ground near the fire while multiple officers surround and apply force; the individual shows no active resistance, suggesting a helpless state during restraint.

A group of individuals is actively engaged in violent unrest: breaking up pavement with sledgehammers and crowbars (frames f0–f8), followed by a large fire/explosion event with thick smoke and sparks, surrounded by a dense crowd (frames f9–f15). The coordinated destruction and subsequent fire indicate collective violent action beyond peaceful protest.

A sudden, intense burst of fire and sparks erupts from a structure or container (visible from f9 onward), accompanied by rapid expansion of smoke and debris—consistent with an explosion rather than a controlled fire. The initial flash and outward propagation support this classification.

A large crowd is gathered around a burning barricade with intense flames, sparks, and thick smoke; individuals are actively engaged in constructing or reinforcing the barricade (e.g., moving debris, using tools), consistent with violent unrest.

Initial ignition event: a sudden bright flash and rapid expansion of fire and smoke at the barricade location, preceding sustained burning; appears as an explosive ignition rather than gradual fire spread.

events.description: Sustained violent unrest in an urban street at night, characterized by large crowds, multiple vehicles (buses, vans, cars) deployed as barriers or in confrontation, and repeated bursts of intense colored light (green, pink, white) consistent with pyrotechnics, flares, or stun grenades. Smoke and haze persist throughout the sequence, indicating ongoing conflict.

A sudden, bright white flash erupts near the center-right of the scene (around the intersection), accompanied by a rapid expansion of smoke and illumination—consistent with a small explosive device (e.g., stun grenade or flashbang). The intensity and abrupt onset distinguish it from sustained fire or lighting.

A second distinct bright flash, predominantly white with pinkish hues, occurs in the upper-left portion of the scene (near building facade), again with rapid smoke expansion and transient illumination—indicative of another explosive event.

A third bright flash, appearing as a cluster of sparks and intense white light, erupts near the top-left tree branches, likely a pyrotechnic or small explosive discharge; visible as a brief but sharp luminous burst not attributable to ambient lighting.
